Their amount will be restored to its original value (shown by the → arrow). This allows your recurrence to stay active and keep generating the following months at their normal amount.
maintenance_convert_zeroed_desc_1: Previously, to temporarily pause a subscription or recurrence (e.g. Audible paused for 3 months), the only solution was to manually set the occurrence amount to 0.00 €.
maintenance_convert_zeroed_desc_2: However, these 0 € amounts mislead the maintenance algorithms into believing the recurrence has been permanently closed or abandoned, triggering auto-closures or false orphan detections.

bank_sync_mirror_transfer_tooltip: This entry corresponds to the credit side of an internal transfer already linked to its sending account. In OmniBank, a single transaction with 'From / To' updates both accounts. It is ignored to prevent double-counting.
bank_sync_review_subtitle: Verify, edit categories or ignore transactions before saving.
bank_sync_all_already_categorized: All new transactions are already categorized.
bank_sync_cooldown_msg: A synchronization was performed very recently. To prevent temporary lockouts or repeated 2FA prompts from your bank, please space out requests.
bank_sync_delete_msg: Do you really want to delete this bank connection and its encrypted keys?
bank_sync_master_pw_modal_msg: Enter your master password to decrypt your credentials:
bank_sync_security_notice: Zero Cloud & Strong Encryption (Fernet AES-128-CBC): Your credentials are never sent to any third-party server. They are encrypted locally on this device using your master password.
bank_sync_security_unlocked_desc: Your credentials are available in memory for automated and instant sync.
bank_sync_security_locked_desc: Unlock the vault to enable scheduled background checks and 1-click sync.
bank_sync_cached_preview_tooltip: View latest preview without querying the bank
config_diag_desc: OmniBank runs with zero external servers or telemetry. If you encounter unexpected behavior or a bug, you can generate a 100% anonymized technical report (with no personal financial data or local paths) ready to paste into a GitHub Issue.
config_diag_note_placeholder: e.g. Projected balance does not update after reconciliation...
diag_toast_copy_report_tooltip: Copy anonymized bug report for GitHub
diag_copied_toast: 📋 Incident report copied to clipboard! You can paste it directly into a GitHub Issue.
bank_badge_found_online_tooltip: Transaction detected on your bank account. Click to reconcile in 1-click!
smart_label_section_desc: OmniBank automatically learns your naming habits and categories whenever you record a bank transaction. You can view, add, or delete your mappings below.
smart_label_no_rules: No matching rules yet. They will be added automatically as you validate transactions.
bank_sync_run_background_tooltip: Queries your connected banks in the background to retrieve recent transactions, detect matches to reconcile, and update your balances without interrupting your workflow.
smart_label_suggested_tooltip: Suggested from your history / matching rules
bank_sync_reset_vault_link: Forgot master password? Reset secure vault
bank_sync_reset_vault_confirm_empty: Do you want to reset the secure vault? Any active memory session will be cleared and you will be able to set a new master password on your next bank connection.
bank_sync_reset_vault_confirm_conns:
⚠️ Warning: Resetting the secure vault will permanently remove your {count} configured bank connection(s) and their encrypted credentials.

Your existing accounts and transactions in OmniBank will remain intact.

You will then be able to choose a new master password upon your next connection.

Do you confirm the reset?
bank_sync_custom_create_bal_hint: Current balance on your bank. When first importing past transactions, the starting balance is automatically retro-adjusted for perfect accounting accuracy.
notif_bank_sync_uptodate_content: Sync completed for {label}: no new bank transactions detected.
acc_realign_hint: If you know your actual bank balance today, enter it below. OmniBank will automatically recalculate the starting balance taking your transactions ({flow}) into account.
acc_realign_success: Starting balance adjusted to {initial} for a current balance of {current}
